questions.question: The Supreme Commander of the Indian Air Force is the:
questions.solution:
__

• Chief of the Naval Staff-Karambir Singh

questions.question: In 2018, with which country did India sign a pact to deepen their cooperation in the filed of environment while affirming their commitment to lead the fight against climate change?
questions.solution:
__
 
• In 2018, India sign a pact with **France**__ to deepen their cooperation in the field of environment while affirming their commitment to lead the fight against climate change.
 
• They also committed to fully implement the Paris climate change agreement at the Conference of Parties (COP24). 
 
• A MoU between the National Institute of Solar Energy (NISE) and the National Solar Energy Institute (INES) in France was also signed.

questions.question: The regulation of the internal environment to maintain a constant state is known as:
questions.solution:
__
 
• The regulation of the internal environment to maintain a constant state is known as **homeostasis**__.
 
• Adaptability is the ability to change in response to a change in environmental condition.
 
• Flexibility is the ability or quality of bending easily without breaking.
 
• Inertia is the tendency of an object which is in motion, to continue to remain in motion, or an object which is at rest, to be at rest, until and unless a force acts upon it.

questions.question: The secretariat of International Solar Alliance is located in __________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The secretariat of International Solar Alliance is located in **India.**__
 
• It is headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana.
 
• The alliance was initiated in India and comprises of more than 122 countries.
 
• Its objective is to work towards efficiently exploiting solar energy in order to reduce the usage of fossil fuels.

questions.question: The physico-chemical process used by green plants for converting light energy into chemical energy is known as _________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Photosynthesis is the process through which plants utilize sunlight to make food and it takes place inside green part (chloroplasts) of the plant.**__
 
• Chloroplasts contain green substance called chlorophyll.
 
• Chlorophyll absorb sunlight for photosynthesis.

questions.question: Who introduced Vernacular Press Act in 1878, which subjected newspapers published in Indian languages to a censorship?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **The Vernacular Press Act was introduced by Lord Lytton (1876-1880).**__
 
• It was enacted to curtail the freedom of the Indian press.
 
• After this, the government kept regular track of the vernacular newspapers.
 
• __**Viceroy, Lord Rippon (1880-1884) repealed the Vernacular Press Act in 1882.**__
 
• Vernacular Press Act (1878) was aimed to cripple regional language newspapers that print against the government by seizing their printing presses.

questions.question: Satyamev Jayate, the phrase written on the National Emblem is taken from which of the following texts?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Satyameva Jayate which means "Truth alone triumphs" is a mantra from the ancient Indian scripture Mundaka Upanisha__d.**
 
• The Mundaka Upanishad is an ancient Sanskrit Vedic text, embedded inside Atharva Veda.
 
• Upon independence of India, Satyameva Jayate was adopted as the national motto of India
 
• It is inscribed in Devanagari script at the base of the national emblem.
 
• The emblem and words 'Satyameva Jayate' are inscribed on one side of all Indian currency.

• The day was observed to increase awareness about the importance of the Indian Air Force.

questions.question: India’s first ever gold medal at the Youth Olympics was won by Jeremy Lalrinnunga. He contested in which event?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Weightlifter Jeremy Lalrinnunga won India's maiden gold in **men's 62 kg category**__ at the Youth Olympic Games held in __**Buenos Aries, Argentina**__ in 2018.
 
• This 15-year-old won the gold medal after lifting a total of 274 kg.
 
• He belongs to the state of Mizoram and he also won a silver and bronze in 2018 Asian Weightlifting Championships.
 
• India won a total of 13 medals in 2018 Youth Olympic Games with 3 being Gold, 9 Silver and 1 Bronze.

questions.question: Which country is the second-largest producer of sugarcane in the world?
questions.solution:

• The sugar industry is the second largest agro-based industry after the textile industry in India.

• Brazil produces around__** 768 million tonnes**__ of sugarcane every year.

questions.question: The bilateral maritime exercise between India and Japan, which was held in October 2018, was called as:
questions.solution:

questions.question: With respect to area, India is about how many times bigger than Pakistan?
questions.solution:
__
 
• With respect to area, India is about **4**__ times bigger than Pakistan.
 
• The area of India is 3,287,263 sq km, while the area of Pakistan is 796,095 sq km.
 
• India's other border countries include Bhutan, China, Nepal, Burma, and Bangladesh.
 
• Border countries of Pakistan (apart from India) include China, Afghanistan, and Iran.

questions.question: Which Indian state/Union Territory has introduced the Happiness Curriculum for school students?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The Deputy CM Manish Sisodia and Dalai Lama launched the '**Happiness Curriculum' in the Delhi government schools on July 2 2018.**__
 
• The new initiative that focuses on holistic education would cover around eight lakh students.
 
• The curriculum focuses on meditation, moral teachings, and mental exercises, with the aim of turning students into good human beings.

questions.question: In which Indian state did black pepper originate?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Black pepper was first cultivated in **Kerala**__ (Malabar Coast of India then).
 
• Black pepper is dried and used as a seasoning or spice.
 
• It is also known by the name peppercorn.
 
• The largest producer of pepper in the world is Vietnam.
